questions.text: Pichli job mein ek din mein kitne ghante khade rehkar kaam hota tha? Shaam tak thakaan kaisi hoti thi?
questions.probe: Koi takleef jo poora din khade rehne ya bag uthane mein dikkat de?
questions.rule: Manual health check. Never ask for a diagnosis.

questions.text: Aapka beauty ka safar kaise shuru hua? Kahan kahan kaam kiya, aur wo salon kis area mein the?
questions.probe: Wahan ek normal din kaisa hota tha — kitne clients aate the?
questions.rule: Less than one year of experience: fresher flag; practical assessment confirms.

questions.text: Us salon mein ek normal facial ka rate kya tha, aur wahan zyada kis type ke customers aate the?
questions.probe: Wahan kaun si brands ke products use hote the?
questions.rule: Tier plus hard-skill results inform PR/PI routing.

questions.text: Wahan se aage badhne ka kyun socha?
questions.probe: Agar wahi cheez UC mein bhi hui to?
questions.rule: Flexibility or short-hours expectations may lower stickiness.

questions.text: Ghar mein kaun kaun kamata hai, aur kya kaam karte hain?
questions.probe: (If married) Pati abhi kaam kar rahe hain? Roughly kitna kama lete hain?

questions.text: Mahine ka ghar ka kharcha kaise manage hota hai?
Pichli baar ghar mein sabse bada kharcha kis cheez pe hua tha — jaise hospital ka bill, school fees, ya kuch aur? Wo kaise manage hua?
questions.probe: Aage aisa koi bada kharcha aane wala hai?
questions.rule: Specific named financial needs inform the assessment.

questions.text: Pichle mahine aapki kamai roughly kitni hui thi? Paisa cash mein aata hai ya online?
Agle 6 mahine mein aap mahine ka kitna kamana chahti hain?
questions.rule: Expectation above approximately twice current earnings may lower stickiness.

questions.text: UC ke baare mein pehli baar kisse suna, aur unhone kya bataya?
questions.probe: Aapko sabse achhi cheez kya lagi?
questions.rule: Assess understanding of the home-service model.

questions.text: Aaj se do saal baad aapka ek normal din kaisa hoga?
questions.rule: An exit plan within two years lowers stickiness.

questions.text: Saal mein kitni baar gaon ya ghar jaana hota hai, aur kitne din ke liye?
questions.rule: Long or frequent trips may lower stickiness.

questions.text: Aapka weekend ka routine kya hota hai — Saturday-Sunday aap kya karti hain?
questions.probe: UC mein weekend aur shaam ko sabse zyada kaam hota hai — un dinon ghar kaise chalega? Ghar walon ki kya raay hai?
questions.rule: Cannot work weekends: mandatory-check outcome defined in workbook.

questions.text: Aur weekdays mein subah se raat tak aapka din kaise chalta hai?
questions.probe: Roz 9–11 ghante aur 4–5 jobs hon, to ye routine kaise adjust hoga?
questions.rule: Part-time-only availability: mandatory-check outcome defined in workbook.

questions.text: Training 12 din (PR) ya 25 din (PI) ki hoti hai, subah 9 se shaam 7, hafte mein 6 din. Aap roz kaise aayengi, aur ghar ka kya intezaam hoga?
questions.rule: Refusal to attend training: mandatory-check outcome defined in workbook.

questions.text: Aapke aas-paas — padosi, rishtedaar, saheliyan — kitni ladies aapse eyebrows ya waxing karwati hain?
questions.probe: Training ke time unme se kitni practice ke liye aa sakti hain?
questions.rule: Fewer than five models: flag for trainer support, not rejection.

questions.text: Training ke baad ₹2,000 ka kit lena hota hai — ye aap kaise arrange karengi?
questions.rule: If more time is needed, ask for the expected date and place on hold.

questions.text: Agla batch [batch date] ko shuru ho raha hai. Kya aap us din se aa sakti hain?
questions.probe: Agar nahi, to exact kis date se? Koi notice period chal raha hai?
questions.rule: Record the committed date. More than 30 days: re-screen.

questions.text: Kya aapka PAN, Aadhaar se linked hai aur dono mein naam same hai?
questions.rule: Manual verification; fix before batch, not an automatic rejection.
